instruction: Search for the personal or institutional websites of the two most recently mentioned authors in the PDF and bookmark them in a folder labeled 'Senior Authors'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-20)

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding and bookmarking the last two authors' webpages. The last two authors (marked with †Equal advising) are Yuke Zhu and Anima Anandkumar. The evaluator checks for a bookmark folder named 'Senior Authors' containing valid URLs for these two authors. This maintains similar complexity to the original but focuses on the senior/advising authors.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirements: bookmark folder named 'Senior Authors' containing websites for last two authors
Metric function properly accesses expected_state parameter directly as rules dictionary (correct for type='rule')
Correctly uses rule.get('names', [])[0] to dynamically get folder name from configuration
Properly handles multiple alternative URLs per author using itertools.product to generate all valid combinations
Uses set comparison to verify any valid combination of URLs is present (one per author)
Getter get_bookmarks reads Chrome Bookmarks file which persists without needing postconfig
Complete coverage: verifies both folder existence with correct name AND URLs for both specified authors
validation.fix_description: Copied metric function from project root tmp_funcs/ to output directory tmp_funcs/. Function already implements correct logic using configurable folder name from rule configuration.
